title: Define LICHEN fragmentation profile
description: Make the SCHC draft authoritative for RFC 8724 ACK-on-Error: allocate directional RuleIDs; confirm M=1,N=6,T=0; choose WINDOW_SIZE, L2 word/padding, tile size, final-tile strategy, RCS placement/input, ACK timing/C/bitmap compression, retry limits, abort behavior, and capacity consistent with constrained C state.
acceptance_criteria: Normative spec has no implementation ambiguity; all selected values have RFC citations and explicit wire diagrams.
close_reason: SCHC draft (spec/drafts/draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md) is now authoritative for RFC 8724 ACK-on-Error: added explicit wire diagrams and canonical octet encodings for ACK REQ (7800/7880), Sender-Abort (78fe, W=all-ones), Receiver-Abort (78ffff, ones-tail), exact-length and non-acknowledgement rules; defined RCS input (CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over reassembled packet + All-1 padding bits zero-extended = packet||0x00) and bit-contiguous RCS placement; specified full 63-bit window bitmap layout with final-tile-at-rightmost-position, zero unassigned bits, RFC 8724 8.3.2.1 compression incl. extend-to-octet step, and RCS-failure final-tile-bit-0 semantics; pinned fixed 10s retransmission timer and bare-ACK-REQ-on-expiry. All values verified against test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json and RFC 8724 sections 8.2-8.4; no contradictions with spec/03, spec/07, link draft frame sizes, constants.toml, or appendix-schc.md.
